subject.title: fix(release): publish ClawHub bootstrap artifacts immutably

question: Does this immutable-artifact handoff and pinned ClawHub workflow satisfy the intended release security boundary for first-publish bootstrap and normal OIDC publication?
rationale: The implementation review found no concrete defect, but accepting a new credential and trusted-publisher boundary for official release automation requires explicit repository-owner intent.

options.title: Approve the boundary

options.title: Require live dry-run proof
